race.description: Narromine Dandy Cup - Saturday 17 Oct Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BADGERS BRIDGE (8) hit the frame two starts ago at Warren but ran below par last time when sixth and beaten 4 lengths over 1100m at Forbes after being prominent at the turn. Finds a more suitable assignment and can get the job done. MAZORT (5) is back after a break of four-and-a-half months. At the last run before the layoff he finished eighth over 1100m at Wellington. Nicely placed and expected to go well while fresh. TUCKLAN (10) was prominent at the turn and finished second last time over 900m at Coonabarabran, beaten 2.5 lengths. Will trim down following recent racing. Placed to advantage so expect another forward showing. BEST DEFENCE (11) can play a leading role here first-up.
